input.quote: (b) NON SOLICITATION. During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: Article X(b) imposes a one-way non-solicit on us (Licensee) running for the Term plus three years and covering every person employed by Licensor and its Affiliates — beyond the 24-month/all-personnel walk-away threshold. The clause does contain an adequate general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-out and no no-hire, so per the redline guidance we narrowed to the fallback with minimal edits: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in performance, 12 months from the end of that involvement, retaining the existing carve-out.

proposal.summary: Narrow one-way 3-year non-solicit to a mutual 12-month restriction covering only personnel directly involved in the Agreement
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the non-solicit mutual and narrowed it to a 12-month period covering only personnel directly involved in performance of this Agreement, as a three-year restriction on all Licensor and Affiliate employees exceeds what we can accept. We are retaining the existing general-advertising / unsolicited-inquiry carve-out.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the twelve (12) month period following the end of an individual's involvement in the activities contemplated by this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who was directly involved in the performance of this Agreement to leave his or her employment with that party. Neither party is restricted from hiring any person who responds to a general advertisement or who approaches it on an unsolicited basis.
